wo-indico-6C6EBF347C.d:
What will you do but not limited to:

• Assist in planning and executing marketing communication campaigns across channels such as social media (Instagram, LinkedIn, TikTok), email, WhatsApp, and website.
• Assist in organizing and executing events, webinars, and brand activations.
• Create and curate content (copywriting, captions, and simple visual assets) that reflects the INDICO products.
• Support the management of the content calendar and ensure timely publishing across channels.
• Assist in drafting press releases, newsletters, articles, and other internal/external communication materials.
• Support the preparation of marketing collateral such as pitch decks, company profiles, and event materials.
• Monitor social media and campaign performance, then compile weekly and monthly performance reports with insights and recommendations.
• Assist in competitor analysis, trend research, and audience insights to improve communication strategies.
• Participate in brainstorming sessions to generate fresh campaign and content ideas.
• Coordinate with internal teams (Sales, Product, Design) and external partners such as agencies, vendors, and media to support smooth campaign execution.
• Maintain and organize marketing assets and documentation (digital and/or physical) in a well-structured filing system.

Requirements

• Bachelor's degree in communications, Marketing, Business, Public Relations, or related fields.
• Previous internship or hands-on experience (e.g., part-time, freelance, volunteer, or organizational projects) in marketing, communications, content creation, or social media management is a plus.
• Strong written and verbal communication skills in both Bahasa Indonesia and English.
• Familiarity with Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, PowerPoint, Word).
• Familiarity with content and design tools (e.g., Canva, Adobe Creative Suite, CapCut) and social media platforms and analytics tools.
• A balanced perspective between creativity and data-driven thinking.
• Basic understanding of branding, copywriting, and digital marketing trends.
• Self-learner, ambitious, good attitude, and excited by challenges.
• Able to work collaboratively in a team-oriented environment while also being proactive and self-motivated.
• Detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines.
• Available for a 6-month internship program.
• Nice to have: portfolio or samples of content/writing (social media, blog, campaign project, etc.).
